mining_power.balanced_detail:
EveryTag mining using about half of your Telefon’s CPU cores. Easy on heat for most people.

Tip: Change the CPU number yourself and the app switches to Benutzerdefiniert automatically.
mining_power.performance_detail:
Aims for higher hashrate by preferring the Telefon’s faster cores when it has them.

May use more power and run warmer. Best when plugged in and cooled well.

On simple Telefons without “fast/slow” cores, this matches Balanced.
mining_power.cooler_detail:
Uses fewer cores than Balanced so the Telefon stays cooler and Akku lasts longer.

Good for overnight or warm rooms. Switch back to Balanced when you want more speed.
mining_power.custom_detail:
Full manual control. CPU starts from your General setting (or 1).

Temperatur and Akku pauses use simple defaults you can change.

Pick Balanced, Performance, or Cooler again anytime to re-apply that profile.

• Keep Wi‑Fi on when the screen is off

general.network_debug_detail:
What it does: Adds a network debug button on the mining screen (works in normal release builds too). It logs whether Wi‑Fi is on, signal strength, and if the pool is reachable.

Why enable it: When mining keeps “retrying”, it is hard to tell if the pool is down or the Telefon put Wi‑Fi to sleep. These logs make that clear so you can fix the right Telefon setting instead of guessing.

Turn it off anytime if you do not need the extra button.

power.title: Keep mining connected
power.intro_short: A few Telefon settings stop Wi‑Fi and mining from sleeping when the screen is off.
power.legend: Green = set · Orange = needs setup · Grey = check yourself · (i) = more info
power.battery_summary_ok: Already unrestricted — good for overnight mining.

power.battery_detail_ok:
Already set: VerusMiner is allowed to run without Akku-saving limits.

Why this helps: Your Telefon won’t quietly pause mining or cut the network just to save a little Akku while you sleep.

Tippe Prüfen if you want to double-check the system setting.
power.battery_detail_need:
What to do: Öffnen Akku settings and choose Unrestricted (or “Don’t optimize”) for VerusMiner.

Why this helps: Phones pause apps to save Akku. That can stop mining or turn off Wi‑Fi overnight. Unrestricted tells the Telefon: keep this app running.
power.wifi_title: Wi‑Fi: stay on when screen is off
power.wifi_summary: On older Telefons set Wi‑Fi sleep policy to “Never”. Tippe (i) for steps.

power.intro_detail:
Mining keeps talking to the pool over Wi‑Fi (or mobile data) even when the screen is off. Phones try to save power by sleeping apps and Wi‑Fi. When that happens you lose the connection, see endless “retry” messages, and earn less — even though the app looks like it is still running.

A few one-time Telefon settings keep the link stable for overnight mining. It only takes a minute and is the most common fix for mysterious disconnects.
power.wifi_detail:
What to do:
• Older Telefons — Wi‑Fi settings → Wi‑Fi preferences → Wi‑Fi sleep policy. Pick option 3, “Never”.
  1. When screen turns off — not good for mining (Wi‑Fi sleeps)
  2. Never when charging — OK if you always mine while plugged in
  3. Never — best choice for stable mining
• Newer Telefons — also turn off “turn off Wi‑Fi when screen is off”, “adaptive connectivity”, or similar power-saving Wi‑Fi options (names vary by brand: Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Pixel, etc.).

Why this helps: The mining pool needs a live connection the whole time. If Wi‑Fi sleeps with the screen, the pool drops you and hashrate stalls until you wake the Telefon.
power.oem_detail:
What to do: In Gerät care, Akku, or App power management, put VerusMiner on the “never sleep”, “unrestricted”, or “no restrictions” list. You can re-open app details anytime to confirm.

Why this helps: Many brands add extra Akku savers on top of Android. Those can still kill mining even after the normal Akku setting looks fine. Whitelisting VerusMiner stops those surprise stops.
power.notification_detail:
What to do: While mining, leave the VerusMiner notification in the status bar. Do not swipe it away.

Why this helps: That small notification tells Android the app is actively working. Without it, the Telefon is more likely to pause mining in the background.
power.locks_detail:
What to do: Nothing extra — VerusMiner does this for you while mining.

Why this helps: The app asks Android to keep the CPU and Wi‑Fi radio from napping during a session. This helps, but it cannot turn Wi‑Fi back on if you (or the Telefon brand) fully disabled it — still complete the steps above.
power.game_detail:
What the app can do: While mining, VerusMiner sends a GameState “gameplay active” hint (Android 13+) so the system may prefer higher clocks. That is not the same as forcing Game Mode = Performance on every brand.

What to do if you have Game Mode / Game Launcher / Game Booster:
1. Öffnen Game Launcher, Game Space, Game Turbo, or Game Mode in system settings.
2. Add VerusMiner to the game list if needed.
3. Set the mode to Performance (not Akku Speichernr / Balanced).
4. Leave thermal / “auto FPS” limits off if you only care about CPU mining.

Tippe “Apply performance hint” to re-send the hint and open app details.

Note: May increase heat and power use. Best when plugged in. Skip if your Telefon has no Game Mode.
power.remind_detail:
What it does: When on, VerusMiner shows this checklist each time you start mining.

Why enable it: Phone updates or Akku-saver changes can reset your settings. A short reminder helps you catch that before you leave the Telefon mining overnight.

You can turn this off anytime. The full guide is always available from Einstellungen or Gerät Information.

quickstart.generate_wallet_body:
Create your own wallet address. This will be used to receive your mining rewards.

Public address/key is shareable however, private key and the 24 seed words are not. Don't loose it or share to anyone.

A warning message will appear when you use a newly created address after you save. Just double check then proceed.

Run your miner to start earning a reward. You can adjust the 'CPU' to a higher value to get a higher hashrate.

Enable the overlay and background process to allow running in the background while the screen is off.

power.ambient_summary: Best mining is often around 18–28 °C room temperature. Hotter rooms need better cooling or Cooler profile.
power.ambient_detail:
Phones throttle or get unstable when they overheat. Aim for a cool room (about 18–28 °C).

Above ~28 °C: improve airflow, remove a case if needed, use Cooler profile, or pause when hot.

Below ~18 °C: usually fine for mining — cold air helps keep the chip cool.

This is a comfort tip for the room/environment, not the Akku % or in-app temperature pause settings.

device.try_builds_hint: These are the best miner builds to try for this Telefon’s CPUs (faster cores first). Compare fairly: run each build about 1 Stunde on the same pool, with similar temperature, power mode, and thread settings — then pick the highest stable hashrate.

power.power_save_detail_off:
System-Energiesparen ist aus — der bevorzugte Zustand für Hashrate und stabile Pool-Verbindung.

Hinweis: Der Akku kann schneller entladen als mit Energiesparen an. Wenn möglich laden. Manche Telefone aktivieren Energiesparen bei niedrigem Akkustand wieder — abschalten, wenn Mining nachts langsamer wird.
power.power_save_detail_on:
Viele Telefone haben einen separaten Energiesparmodus (nicht dasselbe wie „uneingeschränkter Akku“ für eine App).

Ist Energiesparen AN, senkt das System oft CPU-Takte und begrenzt Hintergrundnetzwerk — Hashrate sinkt, der Pool kann trennen.

Für Mining Energiesparen / Batteriesparmodus AUS schalten (oder Auto-Aktivierung stoppen). Besser für Mining, aber der Akku kann schneller leer werden.
power.power_save_summary_off: Energiesparen ist aus — gut für Mining. Der Akku kann schneller leer werden als mit Energiesparen an.
power.power_save_summary_on: Energiesparen ist AN — für besseres Mining ausschalten (CPU/Wi‑Fi können gedrosselt werden).

tools.speed_test_hashrate_note: Ein niedriger Ping bedeutet nur eine schnelle Verbindung zum Stratum-Server. Er garantiert keinen höheren Hashrate — die hängt von Gerät, Leistungsprofil und Pool-Schwierigkeit ab.
